description.zh: 传一份数据的时间约等于往返延迟加上数据量 ÷ 带宽：延迟像水要走多远，带宽像水管多粗；短消息主要被延迟拖慢，大文件才主要受带宽限制，所以加宽水管救不了“卡顿”。
description.en: Sending some data takes roughly the round-trip latency plus size ÷ bandwidth: latency is how far the water has to travel, bandwidth how wide the pipe is; short messages are slowed mainly by latency and only large files mainly by bandwidth, so a wider pipe does not cure lag.

title.zh: TCP 拥塞控制 · 试探与退让
title.en: TCP congestion control · probe and back off

description.zh: 发送端不知道网络还能承受多少，就用拥塞窗口一点点试：每收到确认就多发一点，一旦超时或丢包就大幅退让；网络的稳定吞吐就是这个“加一点、砍一刀”的闭环维持出来的。
description.en: A sender cannot know how much the network can take, so it probes with a congestion window: each acknowledgement lets it send a little more, and a timeout or lost packet makes it back off sharply; steady network throughput is held by this add-a-little, cut-hard loop.

en: why does the network get congested

label.zh: 一条直线：截距是延迟，斜率是 1/带宽
label.en: A straight line: intercept latency, slope 1/bandwidth

reason.zh: 把传输时间画成数据量的函数，是一条直线：截距是往返延迟，斜率是带宽的倒数；加大带宽只让线变平，截距一点不变。
reason.en: Plotted against data size, transfer time is a straight line whose intercept is the round-trip latency and whose slope is one over the bandwidth; more bandwidth only flattens the line and leaves the intercept untouched.

reason.zh: 链路满载时包在路由器队列里排队，延迟暴涨、队列溢出就丢包；拥塞控制读到的信号正是这些延迟和丢包。
reason.en: When a link is full, packets queue in routers, latency soars, and overflowing queues drop packets; those delays and losses are exactly the signals congestion control reads.

label.en: A feedback loop on the sending rate

reason.zh: 发送端测量确认与丢包、据此调整窗口，再看网络的反应——测量、比较、调整，这就是一条反馈控制回路。
reason.en: The sender measures acknowledgements and losses, adjusts its window and watches how the network responds — measure, compare, adjust: a feedback control loop.
